purpose: Reduce something to no more than a stated category.
keywords: That is still only a guess.
In this town, I am merely a traveler.
However expensive it is, if unused it is just an ornament.
restrictions: Often dismisses status, importance, or certainty.
mistake: This evaluates the noun; it is not a location marked by で.

segments.role: Reduce something to no more than a stated category. N + でしかない

examples.translation: That is still only a guess.
examples.note: Limits the strength of the claim.
